name: @atlast/graph-model
description: Topology graph model behind repository interfaces (ADR-0012): S4 temporal foundations — Evidence total order and horizon selection, validity-interval membership, RFC 8785 canonical serialization, collection ordering, and SHA-256 digests per ADR-0016 as amended by ADR-0021. Reconciliation (S5) and snapshots/storage (S6) are gated on their own slice releases.
